checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate assets delivered (4:5 poster, 9:16 story, 9:16 reel)
Warm lantern imagery and coordinated midnight blue and gold design
must.why: All have glowing lanterns, navy background, gold frame and text.

must.item: Each asset includes exact event name, date, time, venue, free-entry wording
must.why: All show the five text items; 'Free Entry' capitalised, which is fine.

must.item: Reel runs 10 s with visible motion
must.why: Frames at 1, 4, 7 and 9.5 s show changing sparkles and lantern positions; the 10 s duration is taken from the frame labels.

must.item: Text legible and unclipped in images; reel holds details long enough
must.why: Text is large, sharp and unclipped. It stays identical in every sampled reel frame. One lantern is cut off at the poster edge, which is a decorative crop.

faults.what: Gold sparkles in the reel drift over the text in the 4 s and 7 s frames. This slightly reduces cleanliness but not legibility.
Large empty area in the lower third of the story and reel. The layout is plain.
Low resolution: 640 px images and 480p reel, from the free plan.

summary: The pack is coordinated and every asset has all five details spelled correctly. The reel keeps the text readable with gentle sparkle and lantern motion. The weaknesses are low resolution and a plain, empty lower third.
